scope: Separate native horizontal instruments using their own source typography, complete prose, original date row and official signature row; retain the existing stricter announcement authorization.

principle.heading: Complete maximal same-style shared-margin original Word/Line run; disjoint real source style before and after the run, nominal syntax, valid quote scope and one native region. An indentation or quoted inline definition cannot create a heading.
principle.body: Own ordered, overlapping horizontal prose with one disjoint source style and a complete sentence, before another candidate heading. Balanced inline definitions can occur in prose; date and signature must have strict valid outside quote state.
principle.date_signature: Complete original finite common source baseline for every date/signature Line; existing source flow validates all original glyphs. The office is an original separately owned all-Han Word ending in 長 or 大臣, followed by original nominal name Words, in the same body column. Office suffixes are semantic grammar, not an issuer/title list.
principle.category: Reuse existing larger_prefix native hierarchy, so a larger original nominal category belongs to its following root; no category name branch.
principle.legacy_rules: This does not generalize every older rule. Existing announcement grammar is explicitly kept under its existing authorization; unknown/incomplete native evidence keeps the old output.

controls: arbitrary nominal titles and office/name Words
own date, own complete sentence, own signature before next heading
missing/foreign glyph provenance, style, role and frame evidence
quoted and malformed/unclosed material; balanced inline and multiline definitions
indented prose wrap and genuine source typography transition
larger category and foreign column; opaque relabeled font/Word IDs
scale, translation and heading line count
missing/nonfinite/mixed original date and signature baselines, including actual PDF XHTML attribute removal
